environment.description: Production log analysis server running Ubuntu 22.04. The CLI tool is invoked by an internal web service that passes user-supplied regex patterns from a Slack bot integration. The PostgreSQL database contains log messages averaging 2-5KB each (full stack traces). The tool runs as a systemd service with no resource limits configured (no CPUQuota, no MemoryMax, no TimeoutSec). The process runs under a standard user account with no cgroup restrictions. Python 3.11 with default re module (no timeout support). Network accessible from internal VPN.

config.db_role: log_reader with SELECT on all tables
config.invocation: triggered by internal web service accepting user regex input
